IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Kline, Prentice, Franklin, Fairley, McAuliffe, Shin and Kohl-Welles

Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the authority of law enforcement to inquire about immigration status of crime victims and witnesses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the immigration status of crime victims,witnesses, and others seeking assistance from law enforcementpersonnel; and adding a new section to chapter 10.97 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 10.97 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: General or limited authority Washington peace officers or speciallycommissioned Washington peace officers, and general or limitedauthority Washington law enforcement agencies, as defined in RCW10.93.020, shall not inquire about the immigration status of crimevictims, witnesses, or others who call or approach these officers oragencies seeking assistance. Officers or agencies who provide publicsafety services shall not request specific documents for the solepurpose of determining an individual's immigration status. However, ifvoluntarily offered by an individual in response to a general requestfor identification, it is permissible to rely on immigration documentsfor the purpose of establishing the individual's identity.
